questions.question: A transfer executes before checking whether the source balance suffices. What ordering prevents that?
options: Execute first, check later
Skip balance checks for speed
Trust all transfer requests
Preconditions checked before any side effect
questions.explanation: Effects precede checks only in incidents. This lesson gates actions on preconditions.

questions.question: Why does run_transfer save status='committed' before calling persist_transfer?
options: To make the transfer look verified without reading DB
To avoid storing the transaction id
To delete the prior balance
To record intent before the side effect so a retry can identify the transaction
questions.explanation: The checkpoint records the idempotency key and transfer details before mutation; the later verify step is what promotes a successful run to verified.

questions.question: After tx-002 crashes immediately after execute, what does its retry return?
options: idempotent-skip, because the checkpoint still has terminal status committed
ok, because it executes the transfer again
aborted-precondition, because the balance changed
verify-fail-rolled-back, because every crash rolls back
questions.explanation: The demo treats committed as a terminal idempotency marker, so the retry short-circuits even though the crash occurred before the normal verified checkpoint.

questions.question: What happens when post-action verification is forced to fail?
options: The checkpoint is deleted
rollback_transfer restores both balances and the prior last_transfer_id
The transfer is marked verified anyway
The destination balance is incremented a second time
questions.explanation: A failed verify invokes the compensating transaction and stores status='rolled-back', returning verify-fail-rolled-back.

questions.question: How does Checkpoint.save reduce the chance of a truncated JSON file?
options: It writes directly over the only copy
It keeps all state only in memory
It writes a sibling temporary file, flushes and fsyncs it, then os.replace swaps it into place
It serializes only the transaction id
questions.explanation: The temporary-file plus atomic replace sequence leaves the previous checkpoint intact if the process dies during serialization.

questions.question: What is the expected result of tx-003 with amount=10_000 and min_balance=200?
options: ok with a negative source balance
verify-fail-rolled-back after the debit
idempotent-skip because the key is new
aborted-precondition with balances unchanged
questions.explanation: 1500 - 10000 is below the minimum, so the workflow saves aborted-precondition and never calls persist_transfer.
